text:
elaine: Quick sync - yesterday CloudLane SEV got messy; partner DM'd multiple engineers asking for bridge.
raj: saw it. gap = no published liaison for that week in shared channel. they assumed anyone could join.
tom: proposal: publish a single-line liaison note every Monday in the shared channel (format: 'liaison: NAME - start -> end UTC') and pin it.
hannah: also pin a 3-item escalation checklist: 1) page oncall, 2) create bridge with `/partner-sev start --template cloudlane`, 3) if partner cannot join bridge, fallback to phone tree and create temp channel.
elaine: agreements: no direct partner pages unless there's a signed escalation agreement and a test drill. default = our oncall pages first.
raj: add partner-facing SLOs to the pin: ack within 15m, triage in 30m, bridge up <60m. auto-escalate to partnership-manager after 2 missed ack windows.
tom: include support-tag mapping: GPU/model -> #eng-runtime, infra/network -> #eng-infra, SI -> #partner-ops. saves time.
hannah: i'll draft the pinned message and the one-paragraph flow by EOD. @raj will approve.
partner-bot: [automated] Template created: /templates/cloudlane-sev-bridge. Reminder: schedule monthly partner contact review.
elaine: thanks. follow-ups: hannah draft, raj approve, tom post weekly liaison schedule.
(tom left the channel) :thumbsup:
